title: Packaging, Versioning, Install, Update, Migration & Round-Trip
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic packaging, versioning, install/update/migration and round-trip preparation over MAS-01..18 while preserving canonical owner, resource/provenance and platform/runtime authority and keeping package/install/migration plans distinct from actual publication, installation or canonical mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent deterministic Adventure packaging/version/install/update/migration/round-trip preparation without treating a prepared package or migration plan as proof of publication, installation, update or canonical owner mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically prepare package/version/install/update/migration/round-trip structures over completed MAS foundations with explicit owner references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner/resource/platform authority and never treating prepared package or migration artifacts as proof that publication, installation, update or migration occurred.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-18 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

MAS-19 consumed explicit MAS-18 prepared references plus validated MIB-05/CNI-01, pack-registry, ARI and CNI-11 owner bindings; invalid bindings, owner-domain mismatches and dangling MAS-18 package source references fail closed.
Prepared package/version/install/update/migration/round-trip structures never proved publication, Campaign installation, activation, update, migration or canonical mutation occurred.
Production code remained frozen after minimum GREEN 4df14adc37ac279a3c42fc19ad1dbc7316fc6243; the proof layer added governance/compliance/verifier surfaces only.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-19.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-19, including current MSLR/MSWI planning; MAS-19 completion unlocks no new cross-program rotation, so MAS-20 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-21+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-19 is closed. MAS-20 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
